title: Kaawisaaji Seede Silsil
intro: Aɗa hawra e limre ɓuuɓnde daartol naatgol Alla. Haala riis kaawis e defaare nde haalaaka, nde ƴoogata e nder jamaanu. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade hol jogorɗo hawrude e ndee ñaawoore keewnde faayiida ?
clues: Mi heɓii nelal diine ngal acci mi haawnaaki
Yimɓe am naamndiima laaɓal am nde ngartu-mi e cukalel
Mi yamiraama yo mi hooru e haalde fotde dumunna
Punndi ndiyam e date ina njokki e am e nder ñaawoore am
Joomiraawo am waɗi lekki kaawis ngam hokkugo am nyaamdu
Maleyka gooto feenii kam e mbaadi neɗɗo timmuɗo

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Jibinde tan ko les lekki paltoor
trial.answer: Jibinde tan ko les lekki paltoor

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Laabi am kollitaama nde ɓiɗɗo am cukalel ngel haali
Leñol am halkaama e jukkungo Alla
Mi ardiima leñol am e poolgu
outcome.answer: Laabi am kollitaama nde ɓiɗɗo am cukalel ngel haali

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
